Screener","url":"https://www.klsescreener.com/v2/news/view/1822549/vitrox-posts-record-3q-as-volume-surges-sees-bright-outlook","publishedDate":"2026-11-05T10:22:45.000Z","text":"ViTrox posts best quarter since listing as volume surges, sees bright outlook | KLSE Screener \n\n## ViTrox posts best quarter since listing as volume surges, sees bright outlook\n\n TheEdge Thu, Nov 05, 2026 06:22pm - 14 hours View Original \n\nKUALA LUMPUR (Nov 5): ViTrox Corporation Bhd (KL: VITROX) is upbeat after the semiconductor equipment maker posted its best quarter since listing in 2005, as higher volume drove down unit costs.\n\nNet profit for the three months ended Sept 30, 2026 (3QFY2026) was RM118.6 million, more than tripled from RM34.7 million a year earlier, according to an exchange filing. Revenue was up more than 110% year-on-year to RM485.1 million.\n\nLooking ahead, ViTrox expects a favourable business environment for the remainder of the financial year and into 2027, supported by robust growth in the semiconductor sector, continued investment in data centre infrastructure and rising demand for edge artificial intelligence (AI) devices.\n\nThe company — which makes machines used to automatically inspect and detect defects in semiconductor components and printed circuit board assemblies — said it is seeking to capture a slice of the increasing complexity of AI accelerators and high bandwidth memory.\n\nNet profit in the first nine months of the year also jumped to RM254.8 million from RM87 million a year earlier, supported by sustained capital expenditure deployment from strong AI infrastructure demand and electronics manufacturing customers.\n\nRevenue for the period also more than doubled to RM1.13 billion from RM552.7 million.\n\n“The group will continue to exercise prudent cost management and operational discipline to mitigate potential risks from foreign exchange volatility and geopolitical uncertainties,” ViTrox said.\n\nNo interim dividend was declared for the quarter under review, though the company had paid out 1.18 sen per share in July.\n\nShares of ViTrox ended Thursday at RM10.60, down 30 sen or 2.8%, giving the Penang-based company a market capitalisation of RM20 billion ahead of the results announcement. \n\nThe content is a snapshot from Publisher. Refer to the original content for accurate info. Revenue was up more than 110% year-on-year to RM485.1 million.\n\nLooking ahead, ViTrox expects a favourable business environment for the remainder of the financial year and into 2027, supported by robust growth in the semiconductor sector, continued investment in data centre infrastructure and rising demand for edge artificial intelligence (AI) devices.\n\nThe company — which makes machines used to automatically inspect and detect defects in semiconductor components and printed circuit board assemblies — said it is seeking to capture a slice of the increasing complexity of AI accelerators and high bandwidth memory.\n\nNet profit in the first nine months of the year also jumped to RM254.8 million from RM87 million a year earlier, supported by sustained capital expenditure deployment from strong AI infrastructure demand and electronics manufacturing customers.\n\nRevenue for the period also more than doubled to RM1.13 billion from RM552.7 million.\n\n“The group will continue to exercise prudent cost management and operational discipline to mitigate potential risks from foreign exchange volatility and geopolitical uncertainties,” ViTrox said.\n\nNo interim dividend was declared for the quarter under review, though the company had paid out 1.18 sen per share in July.\n\nShares of ViTrox ended Thursday at RM10.60, down 30 sen or 2.8%, giving the Penang-based company a market capitalisation of RM20 billion ahead of the results announcement."],"summary":"ViTrox Corporation Bhd (KL: VITROX) posted its strongest quarter since listing (2005) for (\"MFRS\") 134, Interim Financial Reporting issued by the Malaysian Accounting Standards Board, Paragraph 9.22 and Appendix 9B of the Listing Requirements of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad. \n\n The interim financial report should be read in conjunction with the audited financial statements of the Group for the financial year ended 31 December 2025 and the accompanying explanatory notes attached to this interim financial report.\n\n...\n\nB1 Review of performance \n\n Current quarter \n\n Corresponding preceding quarter \n\n ended \n\n 30-Jun-26 \n\n 30-Jun-25 \n\n Changes \n\n Revenue \n\n 374,915 \n\n 183,043 \n\n 191,872 \n\n 104.8% \n\n Profit before tax \n\n 99,946 \n\n 37,907 \n\n 62,039 \n\n 163.7% \n\n Profit for the financial period \n\n 84,495 \n\n 27,807 \n\n 56,688 \n\n 203.9% \n\n Profit attributable to owners of \n\n the Company \n\n 85,043 \n\n 28,133 \n\n 56,910 \n\n 202.3% \n\n The Group's revenue for the quarter under review achieved a stellar expansion of 104.8% or RM191.9 million, surging from RM183.0 million in the corresponding preceding quarter to RM374.9 million. This remarkable top-line performance was primarily driven by explosive Artificial Intelligence (\"AI\") infrastructure demand, our strategic focus into high-value, resilient markets like automotive, and consumer electronics and accelerated global supply chain restructuring which has deepened customer engagements. Our focus on advanced packaging and high-precision inspection solutions directly addresses the increasing complexities of AI accelerators and High Bandwidth Memory (\"HBM\") mirroring the strong momentum seen in the broader semiconductors and electronics manufacturing sector and enabling us to expand our output far beyond the previous year's low baseline. \n\n Profit before tax (\"PBT\") for the individual quarter surged by 163.7% or RM62.0 million, soaring to RM99.9 million from RM37.9 million due to structural manufacturing scale and a highly favourable product mix. Profit after tax (\"PAT\") rose by 203.9% or RM56.7 million, increasing from RM27.8 million to RM84.5 million. This bottom-line outperformance reflects exceptional operational optimization across the facilities alongside the sustained positive impact of income tax exemption enjoyed by the key subsidiary ViTrox Technologies Sdn. Bhd. (\"VTSB\").\n\n...\n\nThe Group cumulative revenue achieved a robust expansion of 98.0% to RM642.0 million, a result of our steadfast commitment to disciplined execution and long-term value creation. We have successfully seized the momentum from strong AI infrastructure demands, alongside growing needs in the automotive and consumer electronics sectors. By leveraging our deep and broad customer base spanning over 30 countries, we continue to deliver advanced Automated Board Inspection (\"ABI\") and Machine Vision System (\"MVS\") solutions that meet the evolving requirements of our global partners with humility and focus. \n\n In tandem with this growth, cumulative PBT rose by 147.4% to RM161.6 million, while PAT climbed 161.6% to RM135.3 million. These results underscore our commitment to operational excellence and disciplined cost management, securing our strong financial position as we scale. \n\n B2 Variation of results against immediate preceding quarter \n\n Current quarter ended \n\n Immediate preceding \n\n 30-Jun-26 \n\n 31-Mar-26 \n\n 374,915 \n\n 267,051 \n\n 107,864 \n\n 40.4% \n\n Profit before tax \n\n 99,946 \n\n 61,659 \n\n 38,287 \n\n 62.1% \n\n Profit for the financial period \n\n 84,495 \n\n 50,782 \n\n 33,713 \n\n 66.4% \n\n Profit attributable to owners of \n\n the Company \n\n 85,043 \n\n 51,197 \n\n 33,846 \n\n 66.1% \n\n On a sequential basis, the Group's revenue expanded by 40.4% or RM107.9 million, ascending from RM267.1 million in the immediate preceding quarter to RM374.9 million. This strong top-line improvement was fundamentally propelled by accelerating shipment deliveries and robust customer pull-ins within both our ABI and MVS segments. This decisive sequential growth emphasizes superior production execution and signals a powerful close to the traditional post-peak transition phase. \n\n PBT grew sequentially by 62.1% or RM38.3 million, rising to RM99.9 million from RM61.7 million in the previous quarter, driven by economies of scale and product innovation. In addition, PAT recorded an increase of 66.4% or RM33.7 million, rising from RM50.8 million in the immediate preceding quarter to RM84.5 million. This sequential earnings acceleration was predominantly supported by the continued positive impact of the statutory income tax exemption received by the subsidiary, VTSB.\n\n...\n\nThe Group anticipates a favourable ...
